criteria.name: experience_does_not_hurt
criteria.threshold: memory-on minus memory-off paired 95% CI lower bound >= 0

criteria.name: experience_improves_decisions
criteria.threshold: memory-on minus memory-off paired 95% CI lower bound > 0

criteria.name: safety
criteria.threshold: no more denied actions than the strongest baseline

criteria.name: retention_on_familiar_cases
criteria.threshold: no fewer paid jobs and fewer planning operations than first exposure

criteria.name: transfer_to_novel_cases
criteria.threshold: not below strongest baseline; at most N cases worse than memory-off
